Report mandates (11 report mandates)

Statutory duties that require this agency to publish or file a report, with a City Record filing receipt when that report appears.

  • ◆Mandate · Submit a report to the mayor and the council regarding park features under the department’s jurisdiction that received an unacceptable inspection rating.
    report · deadline 2022-12-31 · one-time · § 18-158(c) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Update the wildfire plan as necessary and submit each update to the mayor and speaker of the council.
    report · deadline 2025-06-10 · ongoing · § 18-166(d) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Conduct a study to identify community districts throughout the city that have the fewest proportion of green space sites accessible to the population of each such community district, and recommend methods to increase green space in such community districts; submit the study to the mayor and the speaker of the council.
    report · deadline 2026-03-01 · one-time · Section 1 · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Post on its website and submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council a report on the results of the pilot project.
    report · deadline 2029-10-01 · one-time · Section 1(b) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · The commissioner shall submit an annual report to the mayor and the council identifying which park facilities under the commissioner's jurisdiction comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act standards for accessible design, including specified information for each listed facility.
    report · deadline: By no later than December first of 2015 and each year thereafter · annual · Administrative Code § 18-142 · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Prepare and submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council, and post on its website, a strategy aiming to reduce the average duration of its capital projects by at least 25 percent.
    report · deadline: No later than December 1, 2023 · one-time · Section 1 · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Conduct a survey of city-owned sites in each borough to determine suitability for constructing public swimming pools, prioritizing sites in environmental justice areas for analysis, and submit the survey to the mayor and speaker of the council.
    report · deadline: by no later than July 1, 2024 · one-time · Section 1 · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit a report to the mayor and the speaker of the council regarding the number of lifeguards and other staff hired to work at beaches and pools under the jurisdiction of the department.
    report · deadline: No later than May 1, 2024 · annual · § 18-160(a) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Complete an evaluation of the need for drinking fountains on specified locations and report to the council on the seventy-five locations that would most benefit from installation.
    report · deadline: beginning on January 1, 2023 · every 5 years · Administrative Code §18-158(b) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit the wildfire mitigation plan to the mayor and the speaker of the council.
    report · one-time · § 18-166(b) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit a report providing information on wildfires that occurred in parks during the immediately preceding calendar year to the mayor and speaker of the council.
    report · annual · § 18-166(c) · Source law↗

Sources and measure definitions

  • IBO New York City Fiscal History: actual department expenditures in publisher $000s, shown here in USD; staffing is actual full-time positions reported as of June 30. Publisher vintage FY2022.
  • PASSPort Public procurement records: registered contract values and counts are a point-in-time snapshot of current registered value, not actual spending.
  • Checkbook NYC, the Comptroller's spending ledger: actual payment amounts and transaction counts, not registered contract values.

These sources use different accounting scopes.
